findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validation.dnsbl · Private data: kadaster.bag.address, kadaster.bag.address.suggest, kadaster.bag.id, cbs.sbi, cbs.sbi.search, cbs.sbi.detail, lookup.dns.nameservers, lookup.dns.records, validation.dnsbl, dso.documents, dso.plans, validation.email, validation.email.batch, validation.email.disposable, lookup.postcode, validation.iban, lookup.ip, ndw.laadpunten, ndw.laadpunten.detail, ndw.emissiezones, ndw.emissiezones.detail, ndw.truckparking, ndw.truckparking.detail, property.pandgegevens, property.pandgegevens.lite, property.woz.waarde, rdw.vehicle, property.energy.label, scraping.email, validation.vat · Public sink: validation.dnsbl, validation.email, validation.email.batch, validation.email.disposable, scraping.email · Destructive: cbs.sbi.detail, validation.email, validation.email.batch, validation.iban, ndw.laadpunten, ndw.emissiezones.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validation.dnsbl · Private data: kadaster.bag.address, kadaster.bag.address.suggest, kadaster.bag.id, cbs.sbi, cbs.sbi.search, cbs.sbi.detail, lookup.dns.nameservers, lookup.dns.records, validation.dnsbl, dso.documents, dso.plans, validation.email, validation.email.batch, validation.email.disposable, lookup.postcode, validation.iban, lookup.ip, ndw.laadpunten, ndw.laadpunten.detail, ndw.emissiezones, ndw.emissiezones.detail, ndw.truckparking, ndw.truckparking.detail, property.pandgegevens, property.pandgegevens.lite, property.woz.waarde, rdw.vehicle, property.energy.label, scraping.email, validation.vat · Public sink: validation.dnsbl, validation.email, validation.email.batch, validation.email.disposable, scraping.email · Destructive: cbs.sbi.detail, validation.email, validation.email.batch, validation.iban, ndw.laadpunten, ndw.emissiezones

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
